date_selection: Ten unused UTC calendar 23rd days Jan-Oct 2025, not previously present in Stage12-22 date-specific OHLCV model tuning/evaluation

code_lock.entry: Same original V4 D0/D1, first D1 per symbol/day, same 3min delayed 1m open
code_lock.exit: Stage20 bounded 8% stop,18% TP,6h timeout, stop-first intrabar; all source censoring unchanged

experimental_filter.new_condition: Original Stage20 causal quality.relative_60m_return_pp <= 12.0 ; no other changed criteria
experimental_filter.source_and_timing: Only preceding 60m completed 1m from Binance Spot and matched BTCUSDT, both publisher SHA-verified; source from original Stage20 same-run features
experimental_filter.motivation: Prior Stage22 exposed STOP median +15.378 pp and relative rank AUC 0.792 vs 28 valid non-STOP, so 12pp is trained on prior data; disclose candidate in-sample design, test ONLY fresh dates

limitations: Not true historic point-in-time exchangeInfo; archived 504 survivor bias
1m OHLC cannot verify actual L2 execution, stop or TP fill
10 isolated 12h windows still not all-day 2x/5x winner recall
Even a nominal positive result requires true independent other-AI review before any deployment
